name: BACH_0161_FSIM_jpeg3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, clear quality flag, and second-model agreement [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 99%, Invasive 1% | Strongly favors InSitu |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 96th percentile | Quality flag clear |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; largest term, pulling away from invasive [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score, so it lowers the invasive term [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Typical level; associated with lower invasive likelihood, small effect [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; small pull away from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Removal effect equals random (0.002, CI includes 0); not shown to reflect what the classifier used. No top-three concept is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is JPEG-degraded (severity 3) and sits at the 96th OOD percentile, though the reliability flag is clear.
- Closest reference case, BACH_0138, is labeled Invasive and differs in pleomorphism and invasion scores.

## Check on the slide
1. **5, 3, 10:** Largest heatmap contribution toward invasive; confirm in situ morphology, no stromal invasion.
2. **3, 4, 5:** Confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts; this concept is only Weak.
3. **9:** Highest per-region invasive probability (35%); check for gland formation or early invasion.
